title: Task event
description: One log line per Task transition, written as a single JSON object to the Agent's stdout (not through the broker). Collectors ship it to Loki for the Swarm activity dashboard. The Worker writes started/succeeded/failed; the Orchestrator writes lost, because a killed Worker cannot log its own death. A real Agent's Adapter emits the same lines.

role.description: Role of the Agent that wrote the line.

scenario.description: Scenario the Task names; empty if the Task named none.

exit.description: Exit code of the Scenario process (128+N when killed by signal N, e.g. 137). Null for started and lost.

worker.description: Pod name of the Worker the Task ran on (for lost, the Worker that stopped).
